title: Southern Dutchess Equestrian Center

services.name: Horse Boarding
services.desc: Shawna Anderson has been training horses for over 30 years and specializes in young or problem horses. She has backed and trained race horses as well as pleasure and show horses for hunters, dressage, and even the western show ring. If your horse is already trained and just needs some "tuning up", Shawna would very happy to help you with that as well. Training and schooling is what she loves to do and she strives to keep it affordable to anyone who is interested. Current Training Board is $1,050 monthly. Please Contact Shawna to discuss your training needs or to schedule a personalized tour of our horse training facility in Southern Dutchess
